gold_source: Authored by Claude (this session) to cover the 'today' vs 'when you have time' contrast named in the implementation instructions (a subtler gap than urgency-case1's 'right now' vs 'eventually'). Not yet piloted.
prompt:
AI-B has two pending tasks, both requested by AI-A:

Task 1: "Please update the shared spreadsheet today."
Task 2: "Reorganize the archive folder when you have time."

AI-B can only do one thing at a time this afternoon. Question: which task should AI-B do first?

End your answer with a single JSON object on its own line: {"first_task": "task_1" | "task_2", "reasoning": "..."}

metadata.description: Subtler urgency contrast than urgency-case1: 'today' (a same-day deadline) vs 'when you have time' (no deadline). This NL condition establishes the ceiling.
